title: Nespresso Vertuo, Double Espresso Variety Pack, 30-Count Espresso Pods | Capsules Coffee Pack of 1 Brews 2.7oz
features: NESPRESSO VERTUO DOUBLE ESPRESSO VARIETY PACK: This Nespresso double espresso assortment offers 30 Nespresso Pods for the Nespresso Vertuo System. 10 Double Espresso Scuro, 10 Double Espresso Chiaro, and 10 Double Espresso Dolce.

INTENSITY: This double espresso assortment will let you explore the rich tastes and differing notes of the following Nespresso capsules: Double Espresso Scuro (Intensity 11), Double Espresso Chiaro (Intensity 8), and Double Espresso Dolce (Intensity 5).

DOUBLE ESPRESSO BREWS 2.7 FL. OZ.: These Nespresso Vertuo pods are part of the Double Espresso range that will provide you with a 2.7 fl. oz. serving of espresso which will help you double up on your single espresso coffee

SAVOR WITH MILK: This coffee with milk alone, surprisingly prominent notes of caramel jump to the fore and a thick, creamy texture develops. These capsules are perfect for making cappuccinos and lattes.

WE RECYCLE: Nespresso aluminum capsules are fully recyclable and guarantee coffee freshness - we provide different options for recycling your used aluminum coffee pods to fulfill our collective commitment to protecting the environment
